Rank 14 - Service

Laundry and Dry-Clean Order Tracker

Laundry customers want pickup status, item count, due bill, and delivery promise without confusion.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 8,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 500/month is practical for urban shops because order tracking saves disputes and staff time.

7.6Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 8,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,800,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target urban laundry shops, dry cleaners, hostel laundry operators, and pickup/delivery laundry services.

Clothes get misplaced, item count is disputed, pickup/delivery timing is unclear, and bills are written manually.

Every laundry order has item count, status, bill, and delivery date.

Validation signals

  • Existing laundry apps show demand in urban Bangladesh.
  • Dispute reduction has clear value.
  • Pickup/delivery tracking fits mobile use.
  • Repeat customers can be retained by reminders.

MVP modules

  • Order ticket
  • Garment count
  • Service type
  • Pickup/delivery status
  • Customer due
  • Delivery rider note
  • Daily order report

Do not build first

  • Do not build national laundry marketplace.
  • Do not add rider app first.
  • Do not include unlimited SMS.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 10 laundry shops.
  • Print order tags.
  • Make pickup-ready message easy.
  • Add rider flow later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Tagging discipline.
  • Lost clothes blame.
  • Delivery complexity.
Mitigations
  • Item photo option.
  • Clear status log.
  • Delivery as pro module.
